mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% in at least 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) supports strong corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, when UNRATE < 4.0%, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in at least 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1200, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105.0, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in at least 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST < 1200 and INDPRO < 100.0, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5%, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 60% of observations.
